notes.title: Long Gone Days Welcomes New Patch with Simplified Chinese Support!
notes.notes:
Hey there, everyone!

We're absolutely thrilled to share that the latest patch for Long Gone Days is now live, and the game is officially available in Simplified Chinese.

[b]Simplified Chinese Language Support:[/b]

With the addition of Simplified Chinese, we're opening the doors for even more players to embark on the emotional journey of our protagonist, Rourke. With today’s addition, you can now play Long Gone Days in English, French, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish (Latin America), Russian, or Portuguese (Brazil)!

Remember, if you come across any new issues, feel free to use our Discord server or the Bug Report Form here:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfXv306CP8JBND8m5xrzl3AKxy9M4Zv4SX00U-DHynkvX1XPA/viewform

notes.title: Long Gone Days Update 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! 
We’re releasing a new patch for Long Gone Days in which we addressed several issues found by the community during this past week. We want to thank both our Discord community and everyone on the Steam Forums for being such a big help, by reporting every bug they’ve found. Thanks for taking the time to file a ticket and for your patience!

Some of the major issues being addressed are:

[list]
[*] Fixed black screen covering battle outside of the NSB HQ.
[*] Fixed issue causing a battle not resuming after a cutscene was displayed.
[*] Fixed stats possibly reaching negative values.
[*] Adjusted stat percentage gained or loss after using buffs and debuffs.
[*] Fixed softlock on Ivan’s house when interacting with a newspaper.
[*] Fixed event on PL Warehouse forcing the player to fight a battle again.
[*] Fixed “Encrypted” side quest progression being blocked.
[*] Adjusted target morale needed before starting “The Tickets” side quest.
[*] Fixed “Belladonna” being unable to be used on certain conditions.
[*] Fixed softlock related to picking up the medicine multiple times in Aleksander's apartment.
[*] Fixed party members' portraits not updating after reviving them in battle.
[/list]

This patch will also include fixes to other bugs regarding equipment items not displaying their correct stats, clipping and layering issues found on certain levels, corrections made to both localization and text not being translated by a party member and other minor fixes.

Remember to use our Discord server or the Bug Report post on the Steam Community forums if you find any new issues!

See you soon,
[i]LGD Team [/i]

notes.title: Progress Report: Changes to the Morale System + More
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25870705/d4e59d8907ee34b0c284d52af7bb845eefad4e7a.gif[/img]

Here’s a new report on what we have been working on during these past few months.

Since the beginning of the project, one of the pillars of our game has been the [b]Morale system[/b]. Our intention with this system was to show how the events of the game affected our characters, for example how they would react to certain dialogues, how their relationship and trust would change, and how it would affect the ending of each chapter.

The way we decided how morale should work in the game never convinced us 100%. Particularly the way it was linked to the battles, where sometimes it was counterproductive to use skills, or even the benefits of having a state such as “Euphoria”. Taking these factors into account, we took the decision to make some changes that greatly improve the experience.

These changes will be released alongside the last chapter of the game, but they will affect previous chapters. [b]Morale will no longer be used in battles[/b], and will be replaced by [b]Skill Points (SP)[/b]. At the same time, Morale will become a feature that will only affect the game's narrative, in a bigger way than it previously had. It will also continue to be a determining factor in how Rourke and the others react to certain events in the story, and how they perform in their fight against The Core, without being an obstacle during battles.

We also wanted to show you some images of the last chapter and some more changes we have made to the UI of the game, this time featuring our battle system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25870705/1c77c9699cce97e18e0ab2eb9677450261702c38.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25870705/b6e9b43073f70355a9fa8f860adf34fb7cc4c86e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25870705/41c0e798dc54d86955b289bff9ac5b745ec48c63.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/25870705/25a76f9560092cd451d5aa296ef2f6e7e1e6abef.gif[/img]

As some of you already know, during late 2021 and early 2022 we had to take a break due to mental health and burnout issues, but we are back. We hope to be more consistent with our updates from now on, and we thank you very much for your patience while we finish what's left of the game.

That's all for today’s update! Remember that you can follow us on:

Twitter:
[url=https://twitter.com/lgdays]https://twitter.com/lgdays[/url]
Discord:
[url=http://discord.gg/longgonedays]http://discord.gg/longgonedays[/url]

Until next time,
[i]LGD Team[/i].

notes.title: Next Update on July 25!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce that our next big story update is coming out next month!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/96c5081462ddd4697fa6761495b08ec0f7cb6a77.gif[/img]

On July 25th, the game will be [b]automatically updated on Steam[/b]. Several changes and improvements were made to the first chapter, so we recommend playing it from the beginning, but otherwise, we'll add an option to start directly from Chapter 2.

We’ll write a more detailed log on July 25, but here are some of the things included in this update:
[list]
[*][b]PS4 and Xbox controllers[/b] are now supported
[*]Rourke’s [b]walking speed[/b] has been raised
[*]Battles, equipment, items and rewards have been [b]rebalanced[/b]
[*][b]Ivan [/b]can now be used in battle
[*][b]Lynn [/b]and [b]Ivan’s [/b]portraits have been revamped (See [url=https://i.imgur.com/UVEEOqf.png]here[/url] and [url=https://i.imgur.com/zYNbEPM.png]here[/url])
[*]About [b]3~4 hours of new content[/b] (which means the game is now about 8 hours long)
[*]More instances to [b]get to know[/b] your party members
[*]More [b]narrative-focused sidequests[/b]
[*]Lots of [b]bug fixes[/b] that have been reported by our players
[/list]

We also want to take the opportunity to thank everyone who has helped us with feedback using the Steam community forums and our Discord server, none of this would have been possible without you!

See you all next month!

As always, remember you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/LongGoneDays]Discord[/url], or follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/lgdays]Twitter[/url], [url=http://lgdays.tumblr.com]Tumblr[/url] and [url=https://www.facebook.com/LongGoneDaysGame/]Facebook[/url] for more frequent updates!

Cheers,
[i]LGD Team[/i]

notes.title: Long Gone Days 0.1.3 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We've updated the game with fixes to most of the bugs and issues that have been reported from the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/510540/discussions/0/1698294337793062502/]Bug Report Thread[/url].

[b]Some of the fixes included with this update are:[/b]
- Fixed typos and grammatical errors in English and Russian texts.
- Capped the FPS to 60.
- Add visual and sound effects to healing items used in battle.
- Fixed the item "Sweet Cookies", which wasn't working as intended.
- Fix collision on one of the Forest Maps that allowed the player to reach unintented locations.

We're still working on adding an option to [b]remap the game controls[/b], and also adding [b]controller support[/b].

We want to thank everyone who's played the game so far and has taken the time to report all of these issues!

Cheers,
LGD Team.

notes.title: October Update (Development & Upcoming Events)
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/343a92ba6fb4e704cca38dc46c9ebdb3b397ab12.jpg[/img]

Hi everyone! I hope you have been doing well.

We’ve been working really hard on bringing the game with all its features and HD art to Unity. Also, Nikki has been working on a few surprises we hope to be able to show soon!

Besides that, we’ve been polishing the new party members that will join Rourke and Adair on their journey, and soon they will be ready to make their first official appearance! (Here are some GIFs, but since we are working on the scenes that were seen on the demo, it looks pretty similar, except it’s on a widescreen resolution: [url=http://imgur.com/uSK8hl1]Dialogue[/url] & [url=http://imgur.com/H73RPV5]Particles[/url])

[h1]Upcoming Events[/h1]
We’re proud to announce we’ll be part of two events in November!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/79ce8d26b9b15847c1bf499d6d054678d6369e36.jpg[/img]
The first one will be [url=http://dayofthedevs.com/]Day of the Devs[/url], (presented by Double Fine and Iam8bit), where we’ll be showing the demo, alongside a bunch of really cool indie games, and it has FREE ADMISSION! The event will be on [b]November 5th in The Midway (San Francisco, CA)[/b], so go check it out if you’re near the area.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25870705/24377001ccd3a545cfe3ca73629f19e349dfbed9.jpg[/img]
The other event that we’re gonna be a part of will be [url=http://www.gaymerx.com/]GaymerX East[/url], on [b]November 12 and 13 in the Microsoft Technology Center in New York City[/b], where Nikki (Lead Developer) will be showing Long Gone Days at our own table at the Indie Space ◝( ′ㅂ`)و ̑̑

Until next time!
